//: Plain traits for the engine's tests and for a first world (06 §5): a timed stimulant and what follows it, a stance, and a bleed that stacks. What each confers is all it is. Values are illustrative. The attribute and the pools they act on are defined here too, for want of a set of creature stats in `core`.
name: Quickness

//: Quicker for half a minute, at the cost of stamina, and slower for a minute afterwards. Taken again, it starts over.
name: Stimulated

//: Stances exclude each other: taking one leaves the other. A guard turns a quarter of every hit's energy aside; a lunge leaves the body open.
name: Guarding

//: Each stack drains blood; another cut adds a stack and starts the time over. It stops by itself.
name: Bleeding
